prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Place sign-in before adoption certificate creation: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet selection/upload and prior to generating the adoption certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive pet desktop visibility check screen: Insert a dedicated desktop visibility verification screen right before the final home introduction screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_visibility_check", "home_intro"], "new_visibility_check": {"headline": "Desktop Visibility Verification", "body": "Please verify your pet is currently visible on your desktop screen.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "I see my pet on screen", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split layout story intro screen redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout layout separating the background lore from path selection highlights.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose how you want to bring your pet to life on your desktop."}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive desktop controls checklist on finish screen: Add an interactive control guide checklist component on the home_intro screen showing core desktop hotkeys and mouse actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Controls: Right-click pet for settings | Double-click to interact | Hotkey to hide/show", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [finish, copy] Clear desktop interaction instructions on home intro: Update the home intro text to explicitly detail how to control, hide, and interact with the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet at any time to open controls, change settings, or hide the pet. Use your desktop hotkey to summon your pet whenever needed."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account persistence sign-in provider hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen prompting returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with the exact same provider account to access your saved pet."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Split layout for adoption certificate screen: Change adoption certificate layout to split view side-by-side display.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop launch troubleshooting tip on waiting screen: Display a helpful tip on the waiting screen explaining what to check if the pet window does not open automatically.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear on screen within a few seconds, check your system tray or taskbar.", "tip_delay_seconds": 8}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo upload guidance hint for custom pet creation: Add photo selection quality guidelines as a hint on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward for best results."}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign choose_path screen to a carousel layout to showcase path options in a clear visual sequence.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in step inside onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding a new verification screen before home_intro within onboarding is permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving pet introduction functionality is allowed.
Adding an interactive control checklist component to home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.
Updating text copy on the home_intro screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a sign-in provider hint to the sign_in screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Changing the layout of the adoption certificate screen is permitted under Rules 2 and 4.
Adding troubleshooting tips to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a photo upload guidance hint to upload_photos is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the choose_path screen layout to a carousel is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.
